issues.description: The problem statement text (Part 2) requires a method messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) with a double parameter and a return string including the volume, while the UML and the provided solution define Milkable.messageOnMilk() with no parameter (messageOnMilk():String). The template's commented Main also calls messageOnMilk() without a parameter. This conflicting specification of the method signature will confuse students about which interface to implement and prevents them from matching either the textual requirement or the UML/solution consistently.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent. Either: (A) Update the problem text to require messageOnMilk():String (remove the double parameter and the volume in the example) so it matches the UML, template Main, and solution; or (B) update the UML, template examples, and solution to define messageOnMilk(double milkVolume):String and adjust all implementations and examples to accept the double parameter and include the volume in the returned string. Prefer (A) if the intention is the simpler interface shown in UML/solution; prefer (B) if tracking milk volume is required—then update Milkable, Goat, Seal, templates, and tests accordingly.

issues.description: The method messageOnMilk is specified inconsistently across the artifacts: the problem text (part instructions) asks for messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) (including a double parameter and a volume-aware return string), while the UML earlier in the problem, the template/Main usage, and the solution define/use messageOnMilk() with no parameters. This mismatch between the described method signature and the template/solution implementations creates confusion and can lead students to implement the wrong signature or face compilation errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method signature across all artifacts. Preferably, correct the problem statement to match the template and solution by removing the double parameter and the volume-based example: specify messageOnMilk() : String and use the return format "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if volume-tracking is intended, update the UML, template Main usage, Milkable interface, and all implementations to declare String messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and update all call sites accordingly.
